text_block_list.text:
"—The Yasuda Kinen.
At 1600m, it's right at the absolute limit of Seeking the Pearl's current best range."

"The opponent is none other than Taiki Shuttle.
And on top of that—"

The heavens imposed yet another trial.
A bad track condition, Seeking the Pearl's weakness...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
An all-star lineup of blue elements, huh.
Well, that's precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Running through this pack will make it clear.
Just how good I am!
And just how good Taiki is!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san! Lookin' forward
to working with you todaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy ourselves to the fullest, even in the heavy rain!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki... It seems there's really nothing
that can cloud your spirits...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, very well. Let's see if that's really not just a bluff—I'll gauge your depths myself.
—You never know what might happen on an overseas campaign. That is precisely why...
This unexpected stormy weather seemed destined to be the ultimate test of their hidden reserves.
